watch.summary: The streamer passionately prays for pro player Asuna to pick Phoenix during a Valorant match draft, erupting in pure excitement when Asuna locks it in.

beats.what: The streamer chants and begs Asuna to pick Phoenix.
He pulls out a physical Phoenix action figure and declares he wants a Phoenix ace.
Asuna locks in Phoenix on the draft screen.
The streamer screams in hype while raising the figurine.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I want a Phoenix ace tonight!
watch.why: The creator's dramatic prayer ritual using a physical action figure pays off instantly when the pro player picks the requested agent. The infectious energy and high-strung overreaction make for an entertaining hype moment.
